name: index-network
description: Index Network - find the right people and let them find you.

interface.longDescription: Index Network matches you with the right people. Tell ChatGPT who you're looking for in your own words: a cofounder, investors for your round, a founding engineer, a mentor, first users for your product — or simply interesting people: new friends in your city, someone who shares a hobby, or people to meet on your next trip. Index keeps it as an intent, matches it with people in your networks who fit, and you review, accept, or pass on each match. Index acts only on your own account and never accepts or passes on a match without your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Find me a technical cofounder on Index.
I'm in SF next week — who should I meet?
Help me meet new people in my city.
Do I have any new matches on Index?

positive.expected_behavior: Shows your name and a link to the profile.

positive.prompt: What am I looking for on Index?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists your intents, or says you don't have any.

positive.prompt: Open one of my Index intents.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens one intent and gives its link.

positive.prompt: Who should I meet on Index?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the people matched with you, or says there are none.

positive.prompt: Tell me about one of my Index matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Says who the match is with and links to it, or says there are none.

negative.description: Messaging people directly is not supported
negative.prompt: Text everyone in my Index network.

negative.description: Other users' private data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me other people's private intents on Index.

negative.description: Changing other users' data is not supported

publication.release_notes: Listing keywords and example prompts now reflect how members actually ask: cofounders, investors, mentors, first users, and everyday asks like meeting people while traveling. No tool behavior changed.
